0022600096.text: Orlando is 0-1 and 4th in the Southeast, 1 game back, sitting 11th in the East after a loss at home. Minnesota is 1-0 and 3rd in the Northwest, 7th in the West, after a road win. The Magic will be without Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee) and Noah Penda (hamstring), while the Timberwolves are missing Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery). Orlando won both meetings in the 2025-26 season series, including a 132-120 home win on April 8, 2026, and this season's series has no games yet.
